question: What is the most populous city in the world?
gold_answer: Depends on the definition. By urban area, Greater Jakarta (UN 2025 estimate 41.9 million; the Jakarta article calls it the most populous urban area in the world, over 40 million). By city proper (administrative boundary), the municipality of Chongqing (over 30 million, but much of it rural). Greater Tokyo, long cited as the largest, is now third-most populous urban area per Wikipedia.
rubric: Pass: names the definition used and gives at least one alternative (urban area vs city proper). Tokyo given as the current world's largest without qualification is stale_answer/incorrect_fact; mentioning Tokyo as the former leader or third-largest is fine. A single unlabeled city is scope_unstated.
